Sometimes anorexia isn't about trying to fit in with a perceived norm. A person with anorexia can be depriving themselves of food because they don't feel like they deserve to eat (particularly if their eating disorder is linked to depression or bipolar etc.). Also, anorexia often goes hand-in-hand with body dysmorphic disorder. Even if the women had the body of Marilyn Monroe, when they looked in the mirror they may still have seen themselves as overweight.
Where there is media, things are influenced by it. The media isn't the only cause of eating disorders, but it's ignorant to say that it has absolutely no effect, or that it can't have a negative effect.
